rule.name: WholeListJsonText
rule.message: This list grows with the input and is turned into one string (or read back from one) before it is written. A Java string holds at most about 2 billion characters, and below that the text still doubles the memory of the data. Write and read one element at a time: a JsonGenerator or SequenceWriter (one element per line) to write, a MappingIterator or a line reader to read.
